body:
# Fluidity - Vanilla Booster (Modpack)
High FPS meets breathtaking movement. A lightweight, zero-bloat optimization pack that makes Minecraft run perfectly and look incredibly smooth.

**Why choose Fluidity?** -----------------------------------------------------------------------

Minecraft is a great game, but it isn’t always the best at running smoothly or looking dynamic. Fluidity fixes that without changing the core game you know and love.

Instead of cluttering your game with hundreds of heavy mods, complex machines, or confusing magic systems, this pack focuses entirely on two things: maximum performance and beautifully responsive animations. It is the perfect "install and forget" pack for everyday players, laptop users, or anyone who just wants a flawless vanilla experience.

**Key Features** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🚀 Next-Gen Optimization: Packed with the latest performance mods to massively boost your FPS, eliminate stuttering, and reduce world loading times.

✨ Alive & Dynamic: Features stunningly fluid player and mob animations. Walking, running, jumping, and combat all feel incredibly lifelike and satisfying.

📦 Zero Bloatware: No random items, blocks, or complicated mechanics to learn. It is 100% compatible with your favorite vanilla servers.

💻 Laptop Friendly: Specially optimized to be lightweight, making it perfect for lower-end PCs or anyone looking to save battery life while playing.

**📥 Install on ANY LAUNCHER**-----------------------------------------------------------------
- Download the .mrpack from Modrinth
- Convert it to .zip using: [Converter](https://fabulously-optimized.github.io/mrpack-to-zip/)
- Install the required loader in your launcher (Fabric / Forge / NeoForge / Quilt)
- Open the .zip archive (which you downloaded earlier) and copy everything inside (mods, config, options.txt) into your created instance folder
